label: Universal Downloader
title: Universal Downloader: Download Any File Type in Bulk
metaDescription: Download any file type in bulk with proxy support, automatic retries and cloud storage. Streams large files; standby mode for instant API calls.
intro: Give it file links of any type (video, images, PDFs, archives) and it downloads them in bulk to cloud storage, with proxy support, automatic retries and streaming for large files. Standby mode answers API calls instantly.
useCases: Download files that are blocked in your region through a proxy
Move many files into cloud storage in one run
Add a reliable download step to an automation

faq.a: Into the run's Apify key-value store; each row has a direct download link, size, type and how long the download took.

faq.q: Can I use it as a file download API?
faq.a: Yes. Start a run from your own code with Apify's REST API (or the JavaScript and Python clients) and read the results as JSON; the run-sync endpoint returns the items in the same HTTP call. The same input also runs in the Apify Console, on a schedule, or from Make, Zapier and n8n.
